# `lock` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "lock" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/lock/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | The lock id keys name in `key.opens`. |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Where it is and what opens it, for owner review. |
| `tier` | integer 0–5 | required | How good the lock is, 0 (a latch) … 5 (a vault). |
| `pickTier` | integer 0–5 or null | `null` | Lockpicking tier needed to pick it (the minigame is mw-e10); null: it cannot be picked. |
| `sealed` | boolean | `false` | A magical seal: keys and picks fail until a spell dispels it. |
| `tags` | list of id | `[]` | Tags a master key (`key.opensTag`) opens, e.g. "warden-tower". |
| `hint` | string | `"Locked."` | Shown when Interact finds no way past it, e.g. "Locked." |
